integrity: The derivation provides a complete symbolic argument; finite checker diagnostics do not prove the quantified theorem. Earlier full-text layout literature could alter publication-priority conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Analytical result for one-dimensional three-turbine inverse-square top-hat wakes with freestream-normalized linear deficit addition, cubic power, and wake amplitude below 0.3; no calibrated prediction or assertion for quadratic-superposition or varied wind directions.
title: A sharp span threshold for asymmetric spacing of three collinear wind turbines
